description: EasyTdd MCP server — AI-assistant-driven TDD code generation (builders, fluent mocks, test classes) for .NET solutions.
releaseNotes:
6.0.2
- Added help and version commands and validation of startup arguments.
- Migrated legacy settings 0.5 to 6 without replacing customized values, and deployed template compatibility version 6.0.
- Rejected unsupported migrations and future settings or template versions before changing files.
- Reported newer settings or templates as an outdated MCP service, with tool update and restart instructions.
- Preserved custom templates and corrected their upgrade guidance.
- Aligned the MCP server release and generator installation/approved-upgrade target to EasyTdd.Generators 6.0.2.
- Added generator-package check and approved-update tools for eligible project-local references.
